title: Original static factory object construction
limits: Three complete record constructors require full CPU/FS source context and the complete bounded source stack; no coverage exemptions.
The admitted error-aware base constructor 0x4db620 executes unchanged as a whole original dependency; no game helper or physical service is replaced.

Receivers have valid nonwrapping backing of at least 44 bytes for 0x440ee0 and 0x4dc280, or 16 bytes for 0x4dc200; they may be original static storage, and remain disjoint from the active stack and the dependency error-manager/global string-table words.
The factory pointer is stored as an opaque uint32 value and is never called during construction; this family does not own or establish factory execution or scene construction.
Original writable global data and the real inherited FS chain are shared with the caller; unit setup must not reset caller state at nested boundaries.
Normal construction establishes no guest exception dispatch, destructor behavior, connected startup, menu, gameplay or device acceptance.
notes: Boundary verified against hash-pinned v1.0 original. Static entry 59 reaches 0x440ee0 at call 0x43d347 with return PC 0x43d34c, receiver 0x537668 and argument zero. Details are in local packet NOTES.md.
